paper_says: 1,495 cells were sequenced and 723 passed the quality control thresholds.
where: Methods, data processing, quality control and normalization
recomputed: Reproduces. 1,495 cells in the authors' cell table, 723 marked good; all 723 of the 723 cells in their QC table meet the 4 stated thresholds.

paper_says: One of the three epiblast clusters (cluster 4) is only composed of cells from CI-treated embryos.
recomputed: Reproduces. The authors' cluster 4 holds 71 cells from CI-treated embryos and 0 from DMSO-treated embryos.

paper_says: The winner and loser clusters sit at the two ends of the diffusion trajectory of CI epiblast cells, so the diffusion pseudotime from the winner end reads as a losing score.
recomputed: Reproduces. Median losing score in the authors' table: winner 0.07, intermediate 0.94, loser 1.55. A Python rebuild of their diffusion map (Spearman distance over their 1,921 variable genes, destiny-style kernel) rooted at the winner tip gives Spearman rho 0.9998 with the authors' score.

paper_says: 5,311 genes are differentially expressed along the trajectory (FDR < 0.01), out of the genes with more than 15 TPM in more than 10 cells.
where: Methods, differential gene expression analysis along the trajectory
recomputed: Reproduces. 9,916 genes pass the expression filter; a linear trend test of log10(TPM + 1) on the authors' losing score (the parametric part of their GAM) calls 5,278 at FDR < 0.01, 4,029 decreasing and 1,249 increasing toward the loser end.

paper_says: After coverage filters 259 cells and 5,192 mtDNA positions remain; 11 positions, 6 in mt-Rnr1 and 5 in mt-Rnr2, have heteroplasmy that rises with the losing score (FDR < 0.001); Spearman's test gives substantially the same result.
where: Methods, analysis of heteroplasmy; Fig. 6 and Extended Data Fig. 7
recomputed: Reproduces. 259 cells and 5,192 positions pass the same filters; Spearman's test finds 12 positions rising with the authors' losing score at FDR < 0.001, 11 of them among the paper's 11 (300, 303, 304, 305, 326, 327, 1862, 2031, 2074, 2077, 2079, 2081).

paper_says: About 5% of winner, 55% of intermediate and 87% of loser epiblast cells have a mean mt-Rnr1 heteroplasmy above 0.01 (215 cells).
where: Fig. 6h and legend; Methods, analysis of heteroplasmy
recomputed: Reproduces. 6%, 54% and 87% of 215 cells in the E-MTAB-8640 allele table with the paper's coverage rules. The re-count shipped with MitoHEAR, made with a pileup that keeps about 250 reads per position, gives 6%, 51% and 69% of 218 cells.
